hero.title: You decide what to learn. Mai shapes it into a course.
hero.text: Mai isn't a catalog of someone else's classes. Describe what you want to understand, and it becomes a structured course you build, organize, and actually finish — at your own pace.

step1.title: Describe your goal
step1.text: Tell Mai what you want to learn — a topic, a skill, or a book you're working through.

step2.title: Get a structured outline
step2.text: Mai organizes it into sections and lessons you can reshape into a path that fits you.

step3.title: Learn at your pace
step3.text: Work through lessons, track progress, and pick up exactly where you left off.

coursesSection.title: My courses
coursesSection.subtitle: Everything you've built for yourself, in one place.

createCard.title: Create a new course
createCard.subtitle: Start from a topic, a goal, or a document you want to master.
